title: Agnes's Notebook
_how: Each item appears when its anchor is spoken: {seg: narration segment index in timing.json, phrase: words in that segment}; the time is the start of the phrase's last word. Every item gets the same pop-in and highlight, so the notebook never hints at the answer. 'solution' marks run only after 'The Solution.'

items.text: Each cake under a glass dome and a white cloth
Only a number card on each. No names, no labels.
Who-baked-what list: folded in Agnes's handbag
Noon–1 pm: Agnes at lunch; 3 helpers in the hall
1 pm: entry #7 gone. Crumbs left on the plate.
Ollie: “Entry number seven” has gone missing

items.name: Morwenna Day
items.text: sweet peas at the far end
“With the flowers all hour. Saw Hedley pass the cakes.”
“Walked past to the cupboard. Never lifted a cloth.”

items.name: Jago Penhallow
items.text: baker. His own sponge is entry #4.
“Why would I want somebody else's lemon drizzle?”

solution.text: Nobody said which cake. Only someone who lifted the cloth could know #7 was a lemon drizzle.
